spoken_summary: In a Fox News interview, Karoline Leavitt agrees with the host, Jesse Watters, that complaining is gaining traction. She states that her generation, Gen Z, has been raised with "silver spoons in their mouths" and had everything handed to them. She contrasts this with American values of "meritocracy and hard work" and pulling oneself up by one's bootstraps. When Watters asks if it's "laziness," Leavitt replies, "A little bit."

central_claim: Karoline Leavitt, identified as the White House Press Secretary, believes Gen Z is somewhat lazy and has been raised with entitlement, contrary to American values of hard work.
intended_effect: To generate disapproval and anger towards Karoline Leavitt and the political movement she represents, particularly among Gen Z viewers.
